metadata.name: scratchers
metadata.description: Stock Scratchers: VRF scratch cards paying tokenized stock

accounts.name: player
docs: Payer of its own commit, escrow authority of its actions, and the committed account.

accounts.name: vault_token
docs: Stock vault token account, owned by the vault_state PDA.

instructions.name: pay_out_action
docs: Magic Action target (base layer); only reachable via the delegation program's escrow signature.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Signer proves the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

types.name: Card
docs: Lives inside `Player` (no temp rollup accounts). 112 bytes, no implicit padding.

types.name: Payout
docs: Exactly-once payout receipt; PDA ["payout", player, card_id].

types.name: Player
docs: Zero-copy: 3.5 KB would blow the 4 KB BPF stack as a borsh account.

types.name: PriceFeed
docs: Path B price feed: pushed by `pusher` on the rollup (gasless).
